The '''KLC series exchequer droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model produced by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. They were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and were used as exchequers. Their processors were always connected to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] to update their databases about exchange rates.<ref name="ETU" />
